shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with live see-through open air and cross-level pawn AI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, incremental grids, and event-driven work.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics, with documented deviations: floor removal only drops things when the exposed terrain is open air; bomb-punched rooftop holes deferred.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; sync handlers shut down on error, renderer fails open to opaque-below.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T1.2)
- Core (T0): LevelComp registry on pocket maps aligned 1:1, ground comp as column controller, parent.Tile set for real day/night + geology; stairs pairs that generate levels on completion; use-stairs job with safe transfer; PageUp/PageDown camera-preserving level view.
- Sky mountains (GenStep_ABSkyTerrain, stacked-depth presentation): solid mass = mineable edifice or thick natural roof below; the mass rises CONTRACTED by one cell: outer ring = open walkable rock ledge (unroofed, unfogged, lit), eroded core = mineable rock walls under thick rock roof, and only the core interior (second erosion) is fogged so the outer wall row reads as a visible rock face, vanilla-mountain style. Thin-roof overhang strip and unroofed cells = open air; constructed roofs below = buildable rooftop terrain. Map-edge masses stay solid to the border.
- See-below renderer (Harmony): MapDrawer.DrawMapMesh prefix draws the surface map's cached section submeshes at y=-2.5 under the sky map (submeshes above y=2 skipped), dim quad at y=-0.25 (0-80% setting); DynamicDrawManager postfix re-runs the surface map's dynamic draw under a global DrawPos offset flag for live pawns/projectiles (toggleable). Camera far clip raised 65.5 -> 70 (vanilla left 0.5 units of depth at full zoom-out, clipping the below-view).
- Live sync (LevelSync via vanilla MapEvents, no Harmony): ground RoofChanged expands/contracts rooftop live with floor collapse on support loss; sky TerrainChanged drops cell contents when terrain becomes air (pawns 9 blunt + stun, items placed near, buildings destroyed with debris falling through, stairwells collapse with message) and writes constructed roofs under new sky floors; sky ThingSpawned drops anything spawning over air (deferred one frame).
- Stairs landings mine out their 3x3 on any destination level, convert air to rooftop, and unfog.

## Quadruple pass log
T1: reentrancy chains verified. T1.1: far clip 92%, alignment 90%, fog 88%, landing 92%. T1.2 (contract + fog rings): 90%, erosion edge cases audited (map borders, 1-cell spurs, landings). Known quirks: lower pawns' far-zoom silhouettes can draw over sky terrain; water-depth submeshes below may look flat; natural-roof removal under sky mountains not yet handled.

## Tranche plan
- T0 DONE, T1 through T1.2 CODE DONE (T1.2 awaiting in-game verification).
- T2: movement: stair graph, cross-level pathing, drafted moves, pawns auto-use stairs for jobs, non-surface stair placement.
- T3 (next after T1 sign-off, user-requested): cross-map stockpiles/hauling, storage, bills across levels.
- T4: systems: temperature/weather sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish (bomb holes in rooftops, below glow, water depth).

## Status
T1.2 compiled green, pushed. Pending in-game verification: contracted mountain step with visible rock face ring and interior-only fog.
